$comment: UNVERIFIED-UNTIL-FRESH-SESSION-CANARY. Sealed-lane canary enforcement. Settings load only at SESSION START, so these hooks are inert in the session that authored them; the dedicated fresh canary session is what tests whether they actually fire for a subagent. Tool-INVENTORY restriction of the canary is enforced by the agent's own `tools:` allowlist (broker-verified), NOT by a project-wide tool deny here, so the fresh-session orchestrator keeps the tools it needs to run and adjudicate the canary.
